name: Chicha poster
summary: A concert poster in fluorescent ink for chicha music. The maker draws big outlined letters and a tight border by hand, and prints in 2–5 loud flat colours on cheap paper.

philosophy.core_thesis: A fluorescent poster with big hand-drawn letters can call a crowd to a street concert at a very low cost.
design_principles: Draw the headline in big letters with a thick outline and a drop shadow.
Use fluorescent pink, green, yellow and orange, with black for the outline.
Frame the sheet with a tight border of repeat shapes.
Add a photo cut-out of the band or a drawn face, in flat colour.
List the names, the place and the date in a dense block.
Print by screen in short runs on cheap paper.
Let the neon inks clash, and accept a gap or an overlap of 1–3 mm.

process.matrix: A silk mesh screen with a hand-cut or hand-drawn stencil.
process.image_making: The maker draws the letters and the shapes by hand, often with a collage of photo cut-outs, and makes a stencil for each colour.

inks.strategy: Two to five fluorescent and flat inks that overprint with clashes.

screening.rule: Print every area as a flat solid; make a tone only by overprint of two inks.

registration.rule: Hand-pulled colours shift by 1–3 mm; keep an overlap of 0.5 mm between outline and fill.

substrate.stock: A cheap coated or uncoated poster paper, white or fluorescent.
substrate.finish: Smooth, with a slight shine from the ink.

surface.impression: No bite; the screen ink lies as a thick layer on the surface.
surface.sheen: Bright and satin; the fluorescent ink looks to glow.
surface.texture: Flat fields with a mesh grain and clashing overlaps.

evidence.title: Cartel chicha, concert at Puente Piedra
evidence.credit: QM Keen, Wikimedia Commons (a photo of a poster)

emotion.target_response: Joy and noise: the viewer feels a street party, loud and a little psychedelic.

use_cases: album covers for cumbia and psychedelic music
avoid_when: The brand needs a quiet, formal or luxury tone.
The design must stay legible in grayscale.

modifiers.how: Cut the palette to red, black and yellow and use one large bold shape.
Use vibrating colour pairs and flowing, interlocked letters on a swirl ground.
